dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the wide mid-body toward the visible portion of the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients between pigmented mottled regions and the darker baseline canvas.
